conditional_criteria.requirement: URLs, HTTP status, checksums and timestamps make provenance reproducible.
Pipeline, schema, time normalization, ordering and file integrity pass.
Every missing timestamp is enumerated and the missing set is immutable.
No corrected object exists from the same source, endpoint, period and schema.
No interpolation, fill, reconstruction or synthetic substitution is used.
Coverage is at least 99.5% but below the unchanged 99.9% unconditional gate.
Maximum contiguous gap is at most 24 hours.
At most one affected session occurs in any rolling 12-month window.
Required assets and legs use one frozen symmetric common intersection.
The gap is not a hypothesis-defining event, regime or causal window.
Pre-registered sample and replication minima remain satisfied.
Block-matched sensitivity is pre-registered before outcomes.

decision_rule: Conditional admission is permitted only when the 99.9% mechanical coverage subgate fails, all hard integrity gates pass, and every C01-C15 criterion passes. Any failed criterion yields FAIL.
conditional_sensitivity_rule: Remove every eligible fully observed block of equal duration globally, one block at a time, and rerun the exact frozen scientific decision pipeline. If any deletion changes the final conclusion, classify the hypothesis INCONCLUSIVE.

separation_of_states.cause: pipeline failure, experimental failure, or documented official dataset limitation

retroactivity: Permitted only while outcomes remain uninspected and the holdout remains sealed.
immutability: Historical reports and raw artifacts are never rewritten; reclassification creates additive versioned artifacts.
